integrity: All displayed identities are derived from a geometric edge decomposition and rational trigonometric identities; the finite clipping checker is not used as a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: This theorem establishes uniqueness only for centered nondegenerate parallelograms containing the reference disk strictly, not for arbitrary centrally symmetric polygons or general analytic hedgehogs; full text of a relevant 2015 paper was not accessible. Priority remains subject to broader literature and independent review.
title: Centered-strip perimeter tomography is injective on all parallelograms
